QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Trust Me
QuestInfo.1: Bernhardt says he's a perfectly ordinary fellow out for a walk. That's as good a reason as any to eliminate #b100 Permeating Anxieties and 100 Permeating Terrors#k in the #bForest of Sorrows#k.
QuestInfo.2: You learned that Bernhardt was actually protecting someone important. Could it be? Was he protecting the princess?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  168,117,749
Can proceed to [Kritias] Behind the Mask

0.0: Say, you wouldn't be interested in helping a perfect stranger with a violent and dangerous task, would you?\r\n#L0# #bWould I ever!#l\n#k
0.1: You see all those beasties outside Kritias? They're up to no good, let me tell you. Unlike me, who's perfectly normal and trustworthy. Beatrice says they're #bpeople's darkest feelings given physical form#k.\r\n#L0##bThat would explain their names.#l\n#k
0.2: That's right. #bTerror#k... #bAnxiety#k... Those monsters got people feeling suspicious. Heck, even I'M getting scared looks, and I'm a completely upright and normal citizen!\r\n#L0##b...Sure you are, buddy.#l\n#k
0.3: I can't go anywhere 'cause I'm on duty... I mean, busy loitering, but people keep calling me names. Stalker, creep, serial killer. You know, the usual. \r\n#L0##bY-yeah... The usual...#l\n#k
0.4: Maybe if you defeat the #bPermeating Terrors and Permeating Anxieties#k in the #bForest of Sorrows#k, people'll lighten up towards me. What do ya say?

yes.0: Thanks. You're a true friend to the roy... to no one. To me. You're a friend to me.
yes.1: Please eliminate 100 #bPermeating Terrors#k and 100 #bPermeating Anxieties#k. They appear in #bForest of Sorrows 2 and Forest of Sorrow 4#k. Even saying their name out loud makes me shudder.

no.0: Dang it! If I weren't such a normal and unofficial fellow, you'd be in serious trouble for refusing to serve the kingdom!

1.0: Ah, it's good to see you, citizen. Fellow citizen. I am also a citizen, after all.

yes.0: I think I can trust you. Even though I look like a normal guy, I'm actually on a top-secret mission!
yes.1: That's why I'm stuck here. I'd love to crack some monster skulls, but I've gotta stay here and keep her safe.
yes.2: Thank goodness for adventurers like you, helping out the roya-er, top-secret fellows like me!
